title: Why's Steam not getting held more to account?
author: New_Patience_8107
selftext:
Pretty new to the ai game dev world. I am working on something in the background and noticed the furor about the amount of bad quality games showing up on the platform drowning out others. I think whether AI was used or not is irrelevant. It's more people not bothering to bring it through a game development lifecycle and offer a quality product at the end. 

That said if Steam are letting people spoon grool by the ladle it's more so on them for not setting any sort of quality control on the games being showcased. They're the only ones that can regulate the situation and think right now they're just going to let everyone throw shit on the walls and see what sticks.
